name: Wet wipes
common: A small disposable synthetic cloth treated with a cleansing agent, used especially for personal hygiene.

name: Drink cans
common: Metal containers that are used for storing and selling, e.g. beer or soft drinks

name: Tampons
common: A feminine hygiene product designed to absorb the menstrual flow or a plug of material used to stop a wound or block an opening in the body and absorb blood or secretions. The tampon applicator should be recorded within this category.
